name: nginx-multisite
description: Manages Nginx installation and three SSL-enabled virtual hosts with static content, TLS, security headers, Fail2Ban, UFW, SSH hardening, and kernel network hardening.

name: cache
description: Provisions Memcached and Redis caching services, including Redis authentication, logging, startup configuration, and a post-install configuration workaround.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, deploys the FastAPI tutorial application, configures its virtual environment and database, and runs it under systemd/Uvicorn on port 8000.
